“I’ll ask you directly. How is your arm, Shirou?”

The moment we reach the dojo, Tohsaka comes to the point.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“So. First off, how’s your arm doing, Shirou?”
Tohsaka cuts right to the chase when I get to the dojo.

「そうだな。普通に動かせるぐらいにはなった。けど、そういう話をしているんじゃないよな遠坂は」
「ええ。わたしが訊いてるのは、アーチャーの腕として理解できたかって事だけよ」
イリヤは何も言わず、俺と遠坂の様子を眺めている。
pages.jaRuby:
「そうだな。普通に動かせるぐらいにはなった。けど、そういう話をしているんじゃないよな遠坂は」

pages.en:
“Let me see. I can move it more or less normally now. But that isn’t what you’re asking, is it?”

“No. I only want to know whether you’ve come to understand it as Archer’s arm.”

Illya watches the two of us in silence.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well, I can move it fine. But that’s not what you’re asking me, right?”
“Right. I’m asking you if you understand Archer’s arm.”
Illya is watching us silently.

」

昨夜、俺が思い知らされた怖れを知らない。
この布を解けば終わると。
アーチャーの腕を使うどころか、その肌を晒すだけで衛宮士郎の体が崩れると知らないのだ。

pages.en:
“————”

…I swear, Tohsaka does not know what this arm truly is.

She does not know the fear I learned last night.

She does not know that untying this cloth will end me—that even exposing Archer’s skin, let alone using his arm, will cause Shirou Emiya’s body to collapse.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…I swear Tohsaka doesn’t know what this arm is.
She doesn’t know about the fear I felt last night.
It’ll be over for me if I take this cloth off.
She doesn’t know my body will be destroyed if I let this arm free, let alone use it.

pages.ja:
あの感覚を思い出す。
逃れられない死。
生きながら土葬されるような閉塞感。
自分という世界が得体の知れないモノに塗りつぶされ、世界そのものが縮んでいく静かで絶対的な終わり。

pages.en:
—I remember that sensation.

Inescapable death.

The suffocation of being buried alive.

The quiet and absolute ending in which something incomprehensible paints over the world that is *me*, and that world itself steadily contracts.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I recall the sensation.
Unavoidable death.
It felt like being buried alive.
Utter obliteration, where the world is covered beneath something mysterious and ends in silence.

pages.ja:
その一端を味わって、震える頭で繰り返した。
この腕だけは使えない。
使えば死ぬ。
それこそ魔法の助けでもない限り、絶対に死んでしまう。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
I tasted only a fraction of it, yet my trembling mind repeated the same conclusion.

I cannot use this arm.

If I use it, I will die.

Unless true Magic works a miracle for me, I will die without question.
pages.mirrorMoon:
After just a glimpse of it, my mind repeated to itself in terror…
That I cannot use this arm.
I’ll die if I use it.
Without some sort of miracle, I will definitely die.

pages.en:
“Well? A day has passed since I transferred my Magic Crest, so you should feel something by now.

“Answer me. Do you already know what Archer’s arm can do?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“How is it? It’s been a day since I transplanted my crest, so it should be working now.
Answer me. Do you know what you can do with Archer’s arm?”

pages.ja:

？」

てっきりアーチャーの腕を使えるかって話だと思ったのだが……？

“—?”

Tohsaka’s question does not mean what I thought it did.

I assumed she was asking whether I could use Archer’s arm…

“?”

Tohsaka’s question is not exactly what I’d been expecting.
I thought she wanted to know if I could use the arm.

pages.en: “Um… You aren’t asking whether I can control Archer’s arm. You’re asking what Archer’s Noble Phantasm is, aren’t you?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Um… so you’re not asking me if I can suppress his arm, but if I know what his Noble Phantasm is?”

pages.ja:

あ。
遠坂のヤツ、本気で怒ってるぞ、なんか。
pages.jaRuby:
「そ、そんなの当たり前でしょう！ 士郎はアーチャーの腕を使ったらまずいんだから、使わせるワケないじゃない！ なに、それとも使う気でいたっていうのアンタは！」
あ。

“O-of course I am! Using Archer’s arm would be disastrous, so I would never allow it! What, were you actually thinking of using it!?”

Oh.

Tohsaka seems genuinely furious.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“O-Of course! It’ll be terrible if you use Archer’s arm, so there’s no way I’m going to let you! Or what!? Were you thinking about using it!?”
Oh.
Tohsaka’s seriously angry.

“What are you talking about!?”

pages.ja:
「……まったく。言っとくけど、どんな状況になろうとアーチャーの腕だけは使わせないからね。

pages.jaRuby:

“…Honestly. Listen to me: whatever happens, I will not permit you to use Archer’s arm.

“Don’t even think of using it without my permission.

“…You’re supposed to be taking Archer’s place. I can’t have you dying whenever you please.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Geez. Let me tell you. I forbid you to use Archer’s arm, no matter the situation.
And don’t even consider using it without my permission.
…Um, you’re taking Archer’s place, so it’ll trouble me if you die.”

Tohsaka understands.

She knows more than me about what’ll happen if I free this arm.

“So? Have you understood the nature of Archer’s Noble Phantasm?”

I do not know what answer she expects, but that is—well—

“Honestly, Shirou. Tell her already. You’ve known since the moment Archer’s arm was transplanted.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“So, how is it? Do you understand what Archer’s Noble Phantasm is?”
I don’t know what kind of an answer Tohsaka is expecting, but…
“Geez. Why don’t you just tell her, Shirou? That you knew what it is since his arm has been transplanted.”

pages.en:
“Wait. Is that true, Shirou?”

“Urgh—yes, I think so. Archer’s Noble Phantasm is his Projection magecraft—the power to reproduce weapons, right?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Wait, is that true, Shirou?”
“Ughwell, I think so. Archer’s Noble Phantasm is his projection magic, and it’s reproducing weapons, right?”

“…I was nervous for nothing. In other words, you are already connected to it.

“That’s helpful, but why didn’t you tell me, Illya? If Shirou already knew about Archer’s Projection, there was no need for me to confirm it piece by piece.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I guess I didn’t need to be so nervous. So, you’re already connected to it.
That’s helpful in its own way, but why didn’t you say anything, Illya? If Shirou knew about Archer’s projection magic, I didn’t even need to ask him.”

pages.ja: 「どうしても何も、訊かれなかったから言わなかっただけよ。リンはシロウに投影をさせたがっているんだから、伝えるのはリンの役目でしょう。わたしが口出しする事じゃないわ」
pages.jaRuby: 「どうしても何も、訊かれなかったから言わなかっただけよ。リンはシロウに投影をさせたがっているんだから、伝えるのはリンの役目でしょう。わたしが口出しする事じゃないわ」
pages.en: “Because no one asked me. *You* want Shirou to use Projection, Rin, so explaining it was your responsibility. It was not my place to interfere.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “You didn’t ask. You’re the one who wants Shirou to do projection, so it’s your role to ask. It’s nothing I should butt in on.”

pages.ja: 「なによその口ぶり。貴女、あそこまで用意しておいて止めるって言うんじゃないでしょうね」
pages.jaRuby: 「なによその口ぶり。貴女、あそこまで用意しておいて止めるって言うんじゃないでしょうね」
pages.en: “What is that supposed to mean? You haven’t done all this preparation only to stop us now, have you?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “What’s that? Are you going to say we’re stopping after all that preparation?”

pages.en:
“That is for you and Shirou to decide.

“It is true that if you can reproduce the Jeweled Sword, you will win. That is why I assisted you. But I helped only because it was my duty. I never said I agreed with your plan.”

“That’s for you two to decide.

霊体であるサーヴァントを打倒する概念武装を作り上げなくちゃいけないのよ」

pages.en:
“Yes. I want you to reproduce a certain object.

“The two of us cannot defeat Saber or that shadow. We therefore need to create magecraft capable of replacing a Servant—surpassing one. A Conceptual Weapon capable of destroying a Servant’s spiritual body.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yup. I need you to reproduce something for me.
We can’t match Saber or that shadow. So we have to create something in place of Servants, a Conceptual Weapon that exceeds the Servants.”

pages.ja:
「概念武装
？ それって、決められた事柄を実行するっていう、固定化された魔術品の事、だっけ？」
「ええ。物理的な衝撃で相手を打倒するのではなく、概念
魂魄としての重みで相手を打倒する魂砕き。貴方にはその中でも特殊な、遠坂に伝わる短剣を投影してもらうわ」

pages.en:
“A Conceptual Weapon—? A fixed magical artifact that carries out a predetermined function, was that it?”

“Exactly. It doesn’t defeat its target through physical force, but through the weight of its concept—the weight of its soul. An Outbreaker: a weapon that shatters the soul. Among such weapons, I want you to Project a special dagger passed down through the Tohsaka family.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Conceptual Weapon? Is that the fixed magical item that executes a set phenomenon?”
“Yes. It’s an Outbreaker that defeats its opponent using the weight of its concept rather than physical damage. I’m going to have you project a special Conceptual Weapon that has been passed down through the Tohsaka family.”

pages.ja:
「目標はセイバーの宝具に対抗できるだけの物を作ること。
バーサーカーを倒したセイバーの宝具は見たでしょう？
単純な火力で言えば、セイバーは他の追随を許さない。
あの“黒い影”だってセイバーの宝具を受ければ跡形もないだろうし、わたしたちだってあんなものを振るわれたら防ぐ事も躱す事もできない。
けど逆に言えば、急造ですぐ壊れる模造品でも、セイバーの宝具を上回る剣さえ作れれば、あとは戦い方次第ってわけ」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Our objective is to create something capable of opposing Saber’s Noble Phantasm.

“You saw the Noble Phantasm with which she defeated Berserker.

“In pure destructive power, Saber is beyond comparison.

“Even the ‘black shadow’ would be erased without a trace if Saber's Noble Phantasm struck it, and if she turned that attack upon us, we could neither block nor evade it.

“But to put that another way, if we can create a sword that surpasses Saber’s Noble Phantasm—even a hastily made imitation that will immediately break—the rest depends upon how we fight.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“The goal is to make something that can match Saber’s Noble Phantasm.
You saw Saber’s Noble Phantasm that defeated Berserker, right?
In terms of raw power, Saber’s weapon is the strongest.
I’m sure even the shadow would be destroyed by a blow from her Noble Phantasm, and we can’t dodge or block it if it’s used against us.
Conversely, we can manage a fight if we can make a sword that exceeds Saber’s Noble Phantasm, even if it’s an imitation that breaks easily.”

敵の兵器より優れた兵器を作り上げる。

pages.en:
“—————”

…It is sound reasoning. The inevitable conclusion, even.

If Saber’s Noble Phantasm represents the enemy’s greatest output, we need only prepare something that exceeds it by the smallest margin.

Create a weapon superior to the enemy’s.

In battle, that is the simplest and surest equation for victory.

But—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…It’s a sound argument, and a natural conclusion.
If Saber’s Noble Phantasm is their strongest weapon, we just need to prepare something that outperforms it.
Make a weapon that is stronger than your enemy’s.
It’s the simplest and surest way to win.
But.

You might not be able to make a replica with the same power as the original, but you should get close to it if you follow Archer’s theory.”
